tbesh_html:
1) to tingle, quiver
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to tingle (of ears)
1a2) to quiver (of fear)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to tinkle, i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of vibration);
